title: Prove the exact unequal-price five-source binary connector envelope
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact bill for arbitrary positive fixed complete-call prices in the original five-source F2 dirty-connector alphabet, with all 31 nonzero-mask outputs:

```text
base = twice the sum of all 36 operator prices
optimum = base + twice the cheapest source or size-three/size-five output
```

The envelope has 16 irredundant linear pieces, each attained by a 74-call schedule. A cheap singleton, pair or four-element output cannot pay the necessary surcharge. The new finite lemma is that every ten-toggle paired source word misses an odd non-singleton mask. This extends Cinna Davis's #1770 fixed 182-price fixture and retains Ross Richardson's #943/#934 contract and construction credit.

Claim type: scoped proof with a complete finite combinatorial dependency. No new kappa, supplier admission or selected-frontier change. Package: `research/connector-price-envelope`; [claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19079967). The `connector-alphabet-change` assignment is explicitly changed to the general unequal-price decision.

## Evidence

Before: #1770 certifies one unequal source-price vector with unit output prices. After: a written all-positive-price proof and sixteen attaining witnesses determine the entire fixed-tariff envelope.

Local CPython 3.12.15 checks passed:

- Both complete word generators and independent prefix implementations agree on 945 canonical paths. Their histogram agrees with #943; every path misses a size-three or size-five mask.
- All 16 schedules pass free noncommutative action checks, 1,184 two-bit-row basis cases with inverse replay, 512 mixed dirty cases, 20 tariff cases and seven rejection controls.
- Both registered commands pass, timed individually at 0.14 and 0.13 seconds locally. These are single check durations, not performance claims.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight passes on all nine package/input files, with base `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244` reachable from the publication commit.
- The official committed export passes integrity checking. Ordinary and optimized Git-free checks pass in 0.149 seconds each; all ten exported files, including the export receipt, remain byte-identical. A corrupted predecessor input is rejected by its SHA256 pin.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/connector-price-envelope
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/connector-price-envelope --check-source-history
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B research/connector-price-envelope/verify.py --show-witness A31
```

Any CPython 3.12 executable can replace that local interpreter path. Expected marker:

```text
PASS_CONNECTOR_PRICE_ENVELOPE paths=945 witnesses=16 basis=1184 dirty=512 price_cases=20 controls=7 no_new_kappa
```

Generated receipts bind all package files and declared live sources. The witness digest is `5a6e1c58b42488081d44bb5914904d7af4fd9ed6df2c2f8493e995e8ad0280a8`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The exact optimum assumes one dirty connector, immutable sources, generic F2-linear maps, separately paid complete calls and fixed per-operator tariffs. Word-dependent routing, hosting, setup and dispatch require a separate caller ledger. No selected-supplier occurrence, recursive-moment improvement, physical tape implementation, selected cold replay or formal-kernel proof is supplied. The finite obstruction is exhaustively recomputed; a structural proof replacing that census remains open. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

1. Extract all 36 complete tariffs and output demands from one pinned selected-supplier caller. Does it meet this exact contract after admission and instruction costs?
2. Prove structurally that every restored paired five-label walk misses an odd non-singleton mask, replacing the 945-path dependency.

## Related open work

- #4225 studies the same five-source, all-31-mask, single-dirty-connector interface over unsigned F3, attaining three calls per operator. Both interfaces have 36 operators; checked unit-price totals are 74 here and 108 = 3 × 36 there, so the optima differ across characteristics.
- #3909 studies the same five-source/all-31-mask interface with an added paid arity-four source operation. Its original-alphabet baseline 74 calls / 148 dispatch-plus-addition units agrees with this formula at prices one / two, checked numerically. Its extended-alphabet 149-unit lower bound is outside this proof and was not rerun.
- #4189 studies unsigned F3 rather than F2 and leaves the five-source F3 batch open. There is no shared numerical optimum to compare; its six-call one-source result is not re-certified here.
- #3897 adds a joint-output operation on a one-source/two-output boundary. Its dispatch-fusion quantity differs from this fixed 36-operator tariff; no overlapping invoice is claimed.
- #3919 studies an added direct-product operation on the one-source boundary. This theorem keeps the original alphabet; no shared five-source invoice is reported by that work.
- #2817 studies a five-source mutable common-B, two-connector transfer protocol. Its 452-versus-436 ledger is a different contract; no overlapping fixed-source quantity is asserted.

## CI notes

[Hosted run 39483387328](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39483387328) is green on head `f3a717b2040076ce69e7b569fd57d0cf411b35b3`: planning passed in 2m33s and the package replay passed in 1m27s. Both ordinary/optimized hosted scientific receipts match the local committed export exactly, including all source hashes and the witness digest. All registered commands, direct verification, export integrity, Git-free replays and source-history checks passed locally. No unrun local obligation was delegated to CI.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Only the new research package is added.
